To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the palladium homobimetallc complexes 2a,b with a bridging N,N′-diaryl-substituted 1,4- phenylenediamines (L2a and L2b) were synthesized and characterized by cyclic voltammetry and X-ray crystal structure analyses. 2b shows the five-coordinate geometry around the palladium atom.
we have synthesized two homobimetal complexes with a bridging molecule and characterized them by X-ray crystallographic analysis and cyclic voltammograms.
the palladium homobimetalli complexes were synthesized and characterized by NMR, cyclic voltammetry and X-ray crystallography.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new methods for the synthesis and characterization of homobimetal complexes with π-conjugated bridging ligands.
the synthesis of palladium homobimetalllic complexes with a bridging molecule and their application to the construction of molecular devices.
the synthesis of palladium homobimetallc complexes, and the development of new ligands for the synthesis of the palladium homobinetallic complexes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the palladium homobimetallc complexes with bridging π-congugated molecules are promising candidates for molecular electronics.
the homobimetal complexes of palladium with the bridging π-conugated ligands L2a and L2b are stable in solution and in the solid state.
the palladium homobimetallate complexes are useful for the catalytic hydrogenation of carbon dioxide to formate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we succeeded to synthesize the first homobimetalic complexes with a bridging pyridyl ligand and that they show interesting properties in terms of electrochemistry and catalysis.

the palladium homobimetallomacrocycle with the π-bridging ligand, L2b, is a good model compound for studying the electronic interaction between the bridging π-congugated ligand and the metal centers, and for the development of new functional metal complexes.
the π-conjugated ligands, such as L1 and L2a, are able to stabilize the five-coordinate geometry of palladium complexes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the palladium complexes 1 and 2 are stable in the presence of air and water, and that the homobimetal complexes 2a,b are more stable in the presence air than the corresponding monometal complex 1.
the palladium homobimetallc complexes with bridging π-congugated molecules have a potential to be a catalyst for the C–H functionalization of arenes.
the bridging π-conjunctional molecule L2a is an effective ligand for the palladium homobimetallation.
